title: One guest in a busy lounge
intro: The lounge fills up through the afternoon, and a group of friends arrives at 16:34. At 16:58 a guest who paired a watch at check-in sits down among them, upset. The room as a whole looks fine.

decision.why: Set for rest, and bright. Lower light should help people settle.
